bible_verses.english: For the Lord your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory.
What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

He replied, "Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you."

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, when the struggles of life feel overwhelming, help me to remember that You have already won the ultimate victory. I surrender my fears and the battles I am facing today into Your loving hands. Teach me to fight my hardest battles on my knees, trusting in Your unfailing presence and strength. Surround me with Your peace as I choose to praise You through every trial. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels like an uphill battle, it is easy to focus only on the overwhelming obstacles right in front of us. Yet God sees the complete picture, transforming our impossible mountains into testimonies of His grace and victory. Instead of striving in our own strength, we are invited to surrender our worries through worship and prayer. As we lift our hands and bow our knees, we rest in the comforting truth that the ultimate outcome rests securely in His hands.
